version: 1.3.1 (21 Oct 2026) - numbers unchanged; pool_light added; verified against chars swim/float/lie rows 28-39
units: 1x authored px; tile 64x32; z = px above deck plane (deck/coping top = z 0); character frame 64x112, pivot (32,100)

pool.note_surface: water top plane sits 6 px below the deck/coping top, so a 6px inner coping lip is visible on the far (back) edges of the pool

swim.meaning: in the swim/float frames the water surface is at frame y = 100 - 40 = 60 (40 px above pivot, chest height per style sheet v1.3)
swim.offset_meaning: engine draws the swim/float frame 46 px LOWER than a standing frame on the same cell (40 + 6), so frame y 60 lands exactly on the water surface (z -6). Pivot stays at the water cell centre.
swim.mask_rule: engine (or the sheet) clips frame rows y > 60 (below the water line) and may draw the 2-value water overlay there; 1px #7FE0E8 glow line at y 60 where body meets water

pool.swim_zone: manifest asset entries with zone='swim' (pool_water*, pool_* edge/corner pieces have walkable_cells only on deck side). Water cells: walkable for swimmers only; pathfinding switches the avatar to swim anims when entering a swim cell

lounger.lie_pivot: midpoint of the 1x2 footprint (the shared edge of the two cells); seats[].point in manifest
lounger.lie_facing: the direction the FEET point; the backrest (head end) is on the opposite cell
lounger.frame_authoring: lie frames: pelvis 12 px above pivot (frame y 88), head toward the backrest end, lifted to ~z 26-30; breathing +-1 px
lounger.layers: lounger __back (frame, backrest, mattress) under the avatar; __front (front rail/foot end) over it

high_stool.note: reuse 'sit' frames (authored for seat z 14) lifted 12 px; feet dangle on the footrest ring at z ~10

assets.water_cell: outdoor/pool_water_f0..f3.png (+__glow), floor tile 64x32 anchor (32,0), 4 frames @180 ms; manifest zone="swim"
assets.coping_overlays: pool_edge_{n,e,s,w}, pool_corner_{n,e,s,w}, pool_inner_{n,e,s,w}: floor_overlay 64x32 anchor (32,0) drawn on the WATER cell; n=-r edge, e=+c, s=+r, w=-c
assets.spill: pool_spill (deck cells next to water, screen); door_spill (warm, in front of wall_*_glassdoor_outdoor)
assets.loungers: sun_lounger[_towel|_towel_coral]_{se,sw,ne,nw}, footprint 1x2; seats[0].pose="lie", seat_z 12, point = footprint midpoint, facing = feet direction
assets.pool_light: outdoor/pool_light_f0..f3.png: 2x2 floor_overlay (screen), 2 per pool on water cells ~1 tile from the far wall; same frame index as pool_water

draw_order_swim: floor (pool_water) -> coping overlays -> pool_spill -> avatars (swim frames clipped at frame y 60) -> glows
